milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close enough to the birch pressure plate (at spawn-relative 6, 0, 4) and face toward it to confirm visual identification. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at it.

Uses inventory_has because mining a dark oak button drops it as an item into the player's inventory. Dark oak buttons can be broken instantly by hand (no tool required) and always drop themselves. The player starts with no dark_oak_button in inventory, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining.
